newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Sept 10.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Sept 10.

text.p: * ITT Corp said its third quarter earnings would be hurt by weak August revenues in its premium play gaming business, mostly in Las Vegas. Earnings are likely to be near year-ago levels of $0.56 a share, it said.
ITT shares closed up one at 56 on Monday.
* Kentucky Electric Steel Inc said it could post a fourth quarter loss after competition forced it to lower prices. Its shares closed up 1/16 to 7-3/8.
* Canada's Westcoast Energy and Coastal Corp are close to announcing a gas marketing deal. Coastal closed up 3/4 to 40-3/4 and Westcoast finished at C$21.45 on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

* America West Airlines said it expects third quarter earnings to fall below the year-earlier $0.45 a share. It cited high jet fuel prices, industry capacity increases, and aggressive fare sale activity. The airline's shares closed off 3/8 to 12-3/4 and touched a new year low of 12-5/8 during intraday trading on Monday.
* AT&T said it plans to announce one of the largest single-source network outsourcing contracts to date at 1130 EDT/1530 GMT today. AT&T closed at 53-3/8.
